verdict.rationale: The evidence documents an enterprise API ('Programmatic queries via API'), a custom API for GSK, and an official MCP server. None of it mentions an official SDK or client library in any language, and probes found no OpenAPI spec. A raw API and an MCP endpoint are adjacent building blocks, not the official SDKs this story asks for.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can build against official SDKs
